verdict: Partly yes. Removing the TV stages made the high notes clearly less pressed (H1-H2 +1.8 to +6.9 dB at D4-G4, every epoch, about 30-80% of the E1-to-real-cover gap closed) and, in 02:29-03:23 and in 2-8 kHz everywhere, less bright (down to the real cover's level at D4-E4 in the aligned part of that section). Outside that section 4-8 kHz brightness and harmonic tilt did not move toward the cover, H1-H2 is still 5-10 dB below the cover, and 0.3-4 kHz aperiodicity at F4-G4 went further from it. Consonant voicing is unchanged. See harshness.md.
